dialect.detail: Micro Focus COBOL with htmlpp preprocessor, free source format directive, EXEC HTML blocks, CBL_RENAME_FILE/CBL_DELETE_FILE runtime calls, and external-form linkage — consistent with Micro Focus NetExpress or similar web-enabled COBOL environment. Likely part of a Brazilian ERP/accounting system (OPC Rotinas Especiais).

purpose.domain_detail: Brazilian ERP system — restructuring/migration of a receivables/titles file (CRD001.CAD) used in accounts receivable. Program name prefix PWPE and copy file names (PCS50101, PCF50101) suggest OPC or similar Brazilian ERP package.
purpose.summary: This program restructures the CRD001.CAD (Títulos/Bills) data file by reading the old indexed file, validating each record, writing valid records to a new file (CRX001.CAD), then renaming the old file to CRD001_old.CAD and the new file to CRD001.CAD. It is a web-based CGI program with an HTML interface showing progress via a display loop.

notable_features: EXEC HTML blocks (htmlpp preprocessor for CGI/web output)
CBL_RENAME_FILE and CBL_DELETE_FILE Micro Focus runtime calls
Heavy use of COPY with REPLACING for dual-file handling (f01/xf01)
verdict.notes: File uses Latin-1 encoding consistent with Portuguese/Brazilian text (accented characters in comments and string literals). The program is part of a larger Brazilian ERP framework (OPC) with standardized copy libraries. program_type set to online-cics as closest enum for a CGI/web online program (no CICS, but web-based interactive).
